name: Darkness
intro: The Darkness pathway governs sleep, concealment, nightmares and deathly quiet. Its users specialize in control, stealth and weakening enemies through supernatural darkness.

meter.name: Night
meter.spend: Dream Slumber against a sleeping target
meter.full: Enter the dream and deal psychic damage without waking the target

ability.name: Nocturnal Vigor
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Nocturnal Vigor — Immune to Sleep; +10% Initiative; +25% Fear application resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Midnight Requiem
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Midnight Requiem — Deals 125% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Psychic damage (22% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Sleep (blocks actions; wakes on a later hit) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Peaceful Rest
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Peaceful Rest — Immediately restores 12% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; Removes Burn, Bleed, Poison, Curse, Curse link, Silenced, Confused, Sleep, Stunned, Frozen, Freeze, Bound; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Dream Slumber
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Dream Slumber — Deals 80% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Shadow damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy SPEED −30% for 2 turns; 100% chance: Sleep (blocks actions; wakes on a later hit) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; At 100 charge, enter an already sleeping enemy's dream for 200% INT Psychic damage without waking it. Shared accuracy, Dodge and forced-miss rules apply. Waking breaks dream access.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.
